messages:
riley: idea 1 1: to reduce orphaned postmortem actions, propose a lightweight closure workflow: 3 checkpoints (12h, 5d, 21d), a 10-day verification window after "resolved", and a 3-week IC rotation. posting a compact template + comms cadence below for feedback.

kiran: curious about 12h as the first check 1: is that for high-priority only?

riley: good call. default 12h for P1, 24h for P2/P3. the rest (5d/21d) is uniform. idea is earlier touchpoint for customer-impact.

zara: +1 to verification window. recommend verification must include one of: metric delta, canary link, or runbook edit. otherwise we mark as "provisionally closed" and reopen on failure signal.

riley: exactly. also propose a "reopen window": if verification evidence isn't posted within 10 days we auto-reopen and ping owner + oncall-lead.

ops-bot: i can implement reminders. command example: `@ops-bot followup <ticket-id> p1:12h 5d 21d verify:10d notify:owner,oncall-lead`. requires JIRA integration.

riley: template (tiny):
```
PM closure checklist:
- Owner: @name
- Priority: P1/P2/P3
- Acceptance criteria: short + verification method (metric/canary/link)
- 12h/24h check: status / blockers / next step + ETA
- 5d check: progress summary / risk rating / next step
- 21d check: resolved? yes/no + verification link
- Verification window: 10d after resolved -> reopen if no evidence
- Recurrence flag: yes/no (if same service in >3 PMs in 120d)
```

kiran: different from past threads: i'd like a clear escalation rule: if owner reports "Blocked" twice consecutively, ops-bot will create a short "unblock" task and notify oncall-lead. removes manual followups.

zara: comms cadence suggestion: ops-bot posts the 12h/24h/5d nudges in-thread, and weekly digest on Monday for active remediations. also add a 20-min "remediation triage" sync every Wed for items >50% SLO (opt-in for owners).

oncall-lead: about rotation 1: prefer 3-week IC slots starting Monday 09:00 UTC to balance continuity vs churn. secondary covers weekends. roster published in playbook calendar.

riley: one more metric ask: track "verification miss rate" (percent of remediations without verification in 10d), "reopen rate", and "repeat-service count (120d)". set alert when repeat-service >=4 to trigger a cross-team review.

kiran: do we want an automated RCA for repeat-service >=4? maybe auto-create a review ticket and ping platform/product.

zara: yep, auto-create a review card with linked incidents and assign to oncall-lead for triage.

ops-bot: scheduled actions available: `@ops-bot schedule-followups <ticket-id> p1|p2|p3`, `@ops-bot status <ticket-id>`, `@ops-bot digest weekly #eng-oncall monday 09:10`. ops team needs to enable integrations.

oncall-lead: i volunteer to run a 3-week pilot once PR is merged. let's keep pilot scope to incidents with customer impact only for first run.

riley: plan: i'll open a playbook PR with the template, ops-bot commands, rotation roster, and metric definitions by EOD. please review within 48h. if no objections we'll run a 3-week pilot with weekly check-ins.

kiran: i'll help wire the dashboard metrics.

zara: i'll review the verification wording to ensure it's measurable.

riley: thanks all 1 1 1 1 1 this should cut down stale owners and detect recurring patterns earlier.

ops-bot: tip: use `@ops-bot preview <ticket-id>` to simulate scheduled reminders without sending.
